% Pattern: head/proof. Inside a proof, a line that starts with \newline and a
% head starts a claim or the proof of the claim, with no empty line before
% it. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want thm-1 statement/theorem 1
% want proof-1 proof - proves=thm-1
% want head-1 statement/claim 1
% want head-2 proof - proves=head-1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{thm}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{thm} Every compact space is bounded. \end{thm}
\begin{proof} Fix a cover of the space by open balls of radius one.
\newline\textsf{Claim 1.}
The cover has a finite subcover.
\newline\textit{Proof of Claim 1.}
The space is compact. So the space is a finite union of bounded balls.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
